Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the two images, the initial extensive consolidation in the left lung (Figure 1) has largely resolved in the follow-up X-ray (Figure 2), while new patchy consolidations have appeared in the right lung. This pattern of resolving infiltrates in one area and appearing in another is characteristic of migratory pulmonary infiltrates, a hallmark finding of Cryptogenic Organizing Pneumonia (COP).
